title: Every MicroDuck Learned to Walk — My Robot Colony Sim in Unreal Engine 5
author: vimmerio
selftext:
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f3UDgMoKVysA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f3UDgMoKVysA)   
  
I made with Claude a workflow that controls a colony of small robot ducks, minding their own business. They forage for parts, haul them home, build what the nest needs, climb the ladder to lay and sit on their eggs, and shelter when the weather turns. They trip over each other and pick themselves back up. None of that is scripted animation — their movement comes from reinforcement-learning policies trained in simulation and baked into the game. You don't command them.   
  
You keep the place running, and you can reach in. Everything here is in-engine and real time: one continuous 86-second take, one camera, no cuts and no edits. The colony you're watching is playing itself. The camera angles were and trailer cut was entirely made with Claude and Im astonished it can make a game trailer. Music was of course ai generated. Many assets were used from fab for PCG and the envrionment.
